deltas.delta: Default text face changed from the sans stack to the serif initial value on every page; paragraphs, labels and form text all inherit it.
deltas.rootCauseHint: New CSS stack defines --md-font-sans/--md-font-display but no rule applies a body font-family; the browser initial value (Times) wins. Root cause belongs to #62.

deltas.rootCauseHint: Measured identically on all 16 page types at 1440.
